test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify whether the given statements about an earthquake are correct or incorrect.

**Statement 1:** When the stress on the edge overcomes the friction, there is an earthquake that releases energy in waves that travel through Earth's crust and causes the shaking that we feel.

**Statement 2:** An earthquake cannot be identified as a foreshock until after a larger earthquake in the same area occurs.
solution:
The correct answer is **Both Statements 1 and 2 are correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Earthquake occurs when movement of plates __generates stress which overcomes the friction. The release of energy causes __shaking of earth__ known as Earthquake. 
 
• The Foreshock is an earthquake that comes before the larger seismic event, known as the Mainshock.
 
• The__ __smaller earthquakes which comes after the Mainshock are called Aftershocks.
 
• Foreshocks helps in understanding the stress in the Earth's crust and can provide insights for the larger mainshock.
 
• The Mainshock is the most significant earthquake in a sequence that release the majority stress

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Earthquake releases two types of waves:**** ****Body waves and Surface Waves.**
 
• Body waves are Classified as **P-waves and S-waves**. S-waves are more harmful.
 
• Surface waves are classified as** Love waves and Rayleigh waves.**
 
• The point where earthquake arises is known as **Focus or Hypocentre**.
 
• The vertical point of Focus on the surface of Earth is called **Epicentre**.
